# Green Elephant

Human-centred AI literacy and communication coaching by Estève Pannetier and fellow coaches. AI supports human skills, judgement and agency.

## Start here
- [English homepage](https://greenelephant.org/)
- [Accueil en français](https://greenelephant.org/fr)
- [ACX guide](https://greenelephant.org/blog/acx-levels-ai-literacy)
- [Guide ACX en français](https://greenelephant.org/fr/blog/acx-levels-ai-literacy)
- [Satellite Scan](https://greenelephant.org/scan)
- [Satellite Scan en français](https://greenelephant.org/fr/scan)
- [AI Policy](https://greenelephant.org/ai-policy)
- [Privacy](https://greenelephant.org/privacy)

ACX is Estève’s teaching map, informed by his AI and communication research with Arbora. It is not an industry certification or a validated ability test. Level 4 concerns collaboration between team members using AI.

The discovery workshop lasts 3.5 hours including a break, for 6–12 participants (16 maximum). It maps all four levels with practical takeaways at levels 1–2. The four-day coaching journey is hands-on, part-time, for 1–5 participants, practising levels 1–2 with guided level 3 and an overview of level 4.

The Satellite Scan questionnaire and videos are currently English-only. The sales page and Scan checkout are available in English and French. Coaching and training are separate bookings.

Use the visible pages for current terms and details. This file is a reading aid, not an access grant or a promise of search visibility.
